{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in body_mass_g
count_missing = df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Missing values in body_mass_g: {count_missing}')

# Compute mean body mass, ignoring missing values
mean_body_mass = df['body_mass_g'].mean()
print(f'Mean body mass (ignoring missing values): {mean_body_mass}')"}
